safetyPolicy: Visual fixtures evaluate appearance and technique cues only (coarse mash texture, whole-bean count, vegetable dispersion, dressing streaks, and camera framing). Never infer internal temperature, safe doneness, freshness, spoilage, or allergen safety from an image.
